old_str: **Numbers belong in a mouth.** Stat names, Sub-Stat names, Grades, Bands, efficiency, EU, Aether Class and Category are diagnostic vocabulary. why: system and science terms are free in narration; only figures stay in mouths and notes (R78-3, R78-6)

page: Fracture of Worlds — The Living System/III. Physical Force (Part Eleven).md
old_str: **Layer Two: Aether Shell Shielding.** The active Essence field surrounding every practitioner above F-Grade, buffering between incoming force and the body. Density governed by Resilience, particularly Integrity, Hardening and Fortification. The Shell absorbs and redistributes incoming energy across its entire surface before residual force reaches the body. A Shell rated at 5 TJ absorbs 5 TJ across all concurrent attacks before anything reaches flesh.
new_str: **Layer Two: Aether Shell Shielding.** The active Essence field surrounding every practitioner above F-Grade, buffering between incoming force and the body, worn as a coat of the practitioner's own aura. Density governed by Resilience, particularly Integrity, Hardening and Fortification. Held evenly, the Shell absorbs and redistributes incoming energy across its entire surface before residual force reaches the body, and a Shell rated at 5 TJ absorbs 5 TJ across all concurrent attacks before anything reaches flesh. It can be thickened where a blow is expected, at the price of leaving the rest thin, and reading where it went is half of reading the fighter. It is held, not owned: asleep, drugged or taken by surprise, a practitioner keeps the passive hardness of Layer One and loses this layer entirely.
why: active reinforcement over a passive base: aura coat, focusable, leaves gaps, lost off guard (R78-9)
